articles.title: Live tracking NFL free agency: Updates on signings, trades, cuts and rumors
articles.summary: NFL free agency opened with the legal negotiating window at noon ET Monday. We're following all the moves.

articles.title: Free agency: Biggest needs, predictions for 32 teams
articles.summary: Keep an eye on Malik Willis, Tyler Linderbaum, Mike Evans and Jaelan Phillips when free agency opens.

articles.title: Source: Super Bowl MVP Walker to join Chiefs
articles.summary: Super Bowl MVP Kenneth Walker III has agreed to sign with the Kansas City Chiefs, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

articles.title: Colts re-sign WR Pierce, trade Pittman to Steelers
articles.summary: The Indianapolis Colts are re-signing wide receiver Alec Pierce but are trading his running mate Michael Pittman Jr. out of town.

articles.title: Panthers land Phillips on 4-year deal, sources say
articles.summary: Linebacker Jaelan Phillips is signing with the Panthers, according to Adam Schefter.

articles.title: Sources: Ex-Pack QB Willis, Dolphins reach deal
articles.summary: Free agent QB Malik Willis, after reviving his career with the Packers, has reached an agreement with the Dolphins, sources told ESPN.

articles.title: Sources: Bucs adding RB Gainwell, LB Anzalone
articles.summary: The Buccaneers have reached two-year deals with ex-Steelers running back Kenneth Gainwell and former Lions linebacker Alex Anzalone, sources told ESPN.

articles.title: Jets overhaul D, add LB Davis, two pass rushers
articles.summary: The New York Jets struck early and often in free agency, reaching agreements with linebacker Demario Davis and edge players Joseph Ossai and Kingsley Enagbare, sources told ESPN.

articles.title: Source: Kelce tells Chiefs he's back for 14th year
articles.summary: Tight end Travis Kelce, a three-time champion with the Chiefs, has informed the team that he's returning for a 14th season with Kansas City, a source told ESPN.

articles.title: Commanders avoid contract woes, re-sign Tunsil
articles.summary: The Washington Commanders and LT Laremy Tunsil have agreed on a new two-year contract extension with $60.2 million guaranteed and a position-best $32.5 million in signing bonuses.

articles.title: 🏈 Offseason grades: Evaluating all the big moves
articles.summary: We're handing out report cards on big offseason moves, including the Ravens dealing two first-rounders for Maxx Crosby.

articles.title: Last-minute free agency nuggets: What we're hearing on Eagles plans, top RBs and WRs
articles.summary: We give you the latest buzz on top players and teams that could be active.

articles.title: Sources: Falcons eye Tua after Dolphins cut QB
articles.summary: The Falcons are expected to pursue Tua Tagovailoa in free agency, sources told ESPN, after the QB was informed that he will be released by the Dolphins.

articles.title: Bears add ex-Seahawks DB Bryant, sources say
articles.summary: The Bears have agreed to sign former Seahawks defensive back Coby Bryant to a three-year deal worth $40 million, sources told ESPN.

articles.title: Rams add another Chiefs CB, this time Watson
articles.summary: The Los Angeles Rams have added another former Kansas City Chiefs cornerback, reaching agreement on a three-year deal with Jaylen Watson, agent Collin Roberts of Excel told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

articles.title: Source: Likely to Giants, reuniting with Harbaugh
articles.summary: The Giants have reached an agreement on a three-year deal with former Ravens tight end Isaiah Likely, reuniting him with head coach John Harbaugh, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

articles.title: Sources: Ravens reach 3-year deal with Simpson
articles.summary: The Baltimore Ravens and guard John Simpson have agreed to a three-year, $30 million contract, according to NFL Network.

articles.title: Sources: Pats reach deal with pass rusher Jones
articles.summary: The Patriots have agreed to a three-year, $39.5 million contract with free agent pass rusher Dre'Mont Jones, according to NFL Network.

articles.title: Sources: Dolphins trade DB Fitzpatrick to Jets
articles.summary: The Dolphins are sending Minkah Fitzpatrick to the Jets in exchange for the 2026 seventh-round pick from the Chargers, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

articles.title: Sources: Packers trading DL Gary to Cowboys
articles.summary: The Green Bay Packers are finalizing a deal that would send defensive lineman Rashan Gary to the Dallas Cowboys in exchange for a 2027 draft pick, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter. The pick is a fourth-rounder, according to NFL Network.

articles.title: Source: Bucs bringing back veteran TE Otton
articles.summary: Tight end Cade Otton is returning to the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, a source told ESPN's Jeremy Fowler. The deal is for three years, a source told ESPN's Jenna Laine.

articles.title: Sources: CB Stokes back to Raiders on 3-year deal
articles.summary: Cornerback Eric Stokes is returning to the Las Vegas Raiders on a three-year deal worth $30 million with $20 million guaranteed, sources told ESPN's Jeremy Fowler.
